build_triviaqa_data: run the build function to download and prepare the TriviaQA dataset for ParlAI
download_triviaqa_resources: download the TriviaQA-RC tarball using the RESOURCES list of DownloadableFile objects
merge_web_wikipedia_questions: merge web and wikipedia TriviaQA question-answer pairs into a unified noevidence-union JSON file
deduplicate_triviaqa_answers: deduplicate and merge answer aliases across web and wikipedia sources for the same question
review_build_function: review the build function to understand how TriviaQA data is downloaded, merged, and versioned
